title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics priority sampling and SLO-toolkit helpers
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot priority sampling for oncall diagnostics, adds SLO-toolkit helper utilities used by runbooks, improves telemetry and adds end-to-end tests. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: oncall engineers asked for better prioritization of diagnostic suggestions during incidents to reduce noise and focus on high-impact SLO regressions. This PR implements weighted priority sampling in incident-bot's diagnostics pipeline and adds small SLO-toolkit helpers that surface richer context to runbooks. Summary of changes: 1) sampling: introduce a configurable weighted sampler that prioritizes diagnostics by recent error rate, SLO impact, and service ownership score; 2) helpers: add slo_toolkit.get_recent_slo_regressions and slo_toolkit.format_slo_hint to standardize messages in runbooks; 3) telemetry: new metrics incidentbot.diagnostics.sampled and incidentbot.diagnostics.priority_score_histogram; 4) tests: unit + integration tests exercising sampler weights and end-to-end runbook enrichment; 5) docs: updated runbook examples and a short migration note. Testing and rollout: added feature flag incidentbot.enable_priority_sampling (off by default); unit tests and CI pass in all platforms. Feature was staged behind flag and enabled for internal canary orgs for 48h before global rollout. See linked Linear items for evaluation criteria and monitoring playbook. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] integration test with SLO-toolkit mocks - [x] docs updated - [x] telemetry validated - [x] staged rollout performed Backwards compatibility: This is non-breaking when the feature flag is off. When enabled, sampling changes only affect suggestion ordering, not content. Rollback plan: toggle feature flag off; runbook will default back to previous sampling behavior.
